name: Downtown Austin
sub: High-rise condos, historic lofts, and new construction in the heart of the city.
about: Downtown Austin blends high-rise living with walkable access to Lady Bird Lake, the Warehouse District, and the Capitol. It's a top choice for buyers who want to trade a commute for a walk score in the high 90s.
schools: Zoned primarily to Austin ISD: Mathews Elementary, O. Henry Middle School, Austin High School.
commute: Central location with quick access to MoPac, I-35, and downtown employers. Average commute to major tech campuses: 18–25 minutes.

name: South Congress
sub: Eclectic bungalows, walkable shopping, and Austin’s iconic bat-bridge skyline views.
about: South Congress (SoCo) is Austin's most photographed neighborhood — boutique shopping, live music, and bungalow-lined streets a short walk from Lady Bird Lake and the Capitol skyline.
schools: Zoned primarily to Austin ISD: Travis Heights Elementary, Lively Middle School, Travis High School.
commute: Minutes from downtown via South First or South Congress Ave. Average commute to downtown employers: 10–15 minutes.

name: Cedar Park
sub: Family-friendly suburbs with top-rated schools and newer construction north of Austin.
about: Cedar Park is a fast-growing suburb known for highly rated Leander ISD schools, master-planned communities, and easy access to the Lakeline area tech corridor.
schools: Zoned to Leander ISD: Westside Elementary, Cedar Park Middle School, Cedar Park High School.
commute: Convenient to US-183 and the Northwest Austin tech corridor. Average commute to major employers: 20–30 minutes.

name: Westlake Hills
sub: Hill Country estates, top-ranked schools, and some of the most exclusive addresses in Austin.
about: Westlake Hills offers Hill Country privacy minutes from downtown, anchored by Eanes ISD — consistently ranked among the top school districts in Texas.
schools: Zoned to Eanes ISD: Eanes Elementary, West Ridge Middle School, Westlake High School.
commute: Just across the river from downtown via MoPac or Bee Cave Road. Average commute to downtown employers: 12–18 minutes.
